data.one_liner: Edge sync SDK for Flutter enabling offline and online data synchronization across devices.
data.what_it_does: The package provides APIs to synchronize data between devices and a cloud backend, working with or without an internet connection. It supports Android, iOS, and Web platforms and aims to keep data consistent in real‑time.
use_when: you need real‑time data sync across multiple devices
your app must work offline and later reconcile changes
you target Android, iOS, and Web with a single sync solution
avoid_when: you only need simple local storage without sync
your app runs solely on platforms that are still planned (macOS, Windows, Linux)
data.setup_notes: Add the plugin to pubspec, run flutter pub get, and follow the install guide for native configuration on each platform
